ntp.Linux:
# chrony (рекомендуется)
echo "server {IP} iburst prefer" >> /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
systemctl restart chrony
chronyc sources -v

# ntpd
echo "server {IP} iburst" >> /etc/ntp.conf
systemctl restart ntp
ntp.Windows:
# PowerShell (Administrator)
w32tm /register
net start w32time
w32tm /config /manualpeerlist:{IP} /syncfromflags:manual /reliable:YES /update
w32tm /resync
w32tm /query /status
ntp.Android:
Настройки → Дата и время → Сервер NTP:

ntp.MikroTik:
/system ntp client set enabled=yes mode=unicast
/system ntp client servers add address={IP}
# Проверка:
/system ntp client print
ntp.Cisco:

! Проверка:
show ntp status
show ntp associations
ntp.Procurve:
